test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence. "He had lost the keys before the meeting."

options.text: The keys had lost before the meeting.
The keys had been lost by him before the meeting.
The keys were lost by him.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "He had lost the keys before the meeting."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the keys" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had lost" to "had been lost" (past perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "him."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "before the meeting" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The keys had been lost by him before the meeting."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The keys had lost before the meeting." – Incorrect sentence structure; the verb is not in the passive form.
 
• **Option 2: **"The keys has been lost." – Incorrect tense (present perfect instead of past perfect).
 
• **Option 4: **"The keys were lost by him." – Incorrect tense (past simple instead of past perfect).
